headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest revenue and profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI contributions were highlighted by several firms, boosting margins for HCLTech and TCS but not enough to offset profit declines at Infosys and Wipro. Dividend payouts remained steady, with most companies maintaining or modestly raising them. Guidance was mixed, with Infosys trimming its FY27 outlook and others keeping guidance unchanged.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI revenue grew sharply at Infosys (29% YoY), HCLTech ($219 m) and TCS (annualised $3.1 bn), supporting profit growth at the latter two.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin guidance to 16% and HCLTech posted an operating margin of 18.2%, reflecting better cost control.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most firms kept or modestly increased interim dividends, signalling confidence in cash flow.

themes.title: Profit pressure
themes.detail: Infosys and Wipro saw profit growth dip, with Infosys profit up only 6% YoY and Wipro profit down 1.9% YoY.
